message: 囮捜査で大捕物

name: Synn
message: 「An incident...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Apparently, one of our female students fell victim to something.」

name: Synn
message: 「And that's why it's you and me?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's on Helena-san's orders, so I don't have a choice, okay?! Not a choice!!」
Out of all possible pairings, she leaves just me and Misa alone together... What on earth is Helena-san thinking?

name: Synn
message: 「I... I get it! She's definitely testing the trust between us!」

name: Misa
message: 「There's zero need to test that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... So we're rock solid, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「There's a limit to how positively you can spin things!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what am I supposed to do?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. You have your own duties to handle, so you don't have to force yourself to come along.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll just stay late to finish them, so it's fine. No need to worry.」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I'd ever worry about you!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's just trying to get rid of ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, just come out and say so.」

name: Misa
message: 「If I say so, will you actually go home?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're so stubborn!!」
That's the last thing I want to hear from Misa of all people.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want any weird incidents popping up. Kirafes is right around the corner, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「As head of security, I can't overlook this either. I'm going to solve it no matter what it takes.」
For all her complaining, she really is dedicated to her job.

name: Misa
message: 「Shio... Could it be that you're the victim?」

name: Shio
message: 「What a blunder... Ngh, the blunder of a lifetime...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What happened...」

name: Shio
message: 「For such an unworthy and immature blunder, I must atone with my life」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh?」
Saying that, Shio-chan pressed her naginata against her stomach.

name: Shio
message: 「I see, you have come to serve as my second, have you not!!」

name: Misa
message: 「No I haven't!! Hey, cut that out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Just tell us what happened first」

name: Shio
message: 「I am deeply grateful for your concern. However!! This is not a matter that can be spoken of to a man!!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it」
I cover my ears and turn my back.

name: Synn
message: 「Rea~dy yet?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're good」

name: Shio
message: 「I... am so overcome with shame that I can hardly bear it...!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you, stop trying to commit HARAKIRI!!」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall perform seppuku!!」
In the end, I still have no idea what's going on.

name: Paqy
message: 「Apparently her panties got stolen」

name: Synn
message: 「Panties!?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is a loincloth!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san, you have zero tact!! It's because your owner doesn't keep you in line!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's my fault?」

name: Shio
message: 「I will never be able to wed... *sob, sob*」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't worry, Shio. Nobody knows except us, so it'll be fine」
I see. Helena-san was being considerate of Shio-chan, so she sent Misa over.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, then why am I...?」

name: Helena
message: 「The culprit might be a violent thug, right? That's why we need a man's help」

name: Misa
message: 「An unreliable man's help, you mean. I'm more than enough on my own」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Helena-san!?」

name: Helena
message: 「I suppose I've grasped the gist of the situation. As for me, I can't just leave a case like this alone, though--」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right. We'll catch the culprit ourselves. Right, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't take the lead on your own!! If we're up against a thug, we have Shio too, and--」

name: Shio
message: 「Sob, sob...」
It seems to have really taken a toll on her.

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. Make sure you protect them properly, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. This is a good opportunity to prove that's unnecessary」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well! That's the spirit! I'm praying for your success」

name: Synn
message: 「So our target is an underwear thief...」

name: Misa
message: 「If there's prey to be had, the plan is simple. We just need to lure the culprit out」

name: Synn
message: 「How?」

name: Misa
message: 「Heheh~ You can't even figure that much out?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, a decoy」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say the answer before I do!!」

name: Synn
message: 「A decoy means setting things up so the underwear gets stolen, right? And that underwear would be--mine?」

name: Misa
message: 「You idiot!! What got stolen was Shio's underwear!? Why on earth would anyone steal a guy's underwear!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, true. Which means... yeah! Nanaka will definitely understand」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you bringing up Nanaka-san!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Given the circumstances and all」

name: Misa
message: 「There's someone perfectly suited for the role standing right in front of you, isn't there!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, Paqy!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're makin' me blush」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm kidding」

name: Paqy
message: 「That hurts!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I thought it might help you relax」

name: Misa
message: 「It had the exact opposite effect! You're completely throwing off my rhythm」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, Misa, you're going to...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. After all, this is the mission assigned to me」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way, Misa... Y-You can't do that\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't underestimate me. A pair or two of underwear is no big deal」

name: Synn
message: 「But taking them off right here and now...!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What am I supposed to do...\s03 Should I look the other way again?」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I'd ever do that!? I'm going to bring them from home!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... That's a relief」

name: Misa
message: 「You just jumped to conclusions on your own. Always saying unnecessary things」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it... I'll shut up and focus on guarding you」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't look over here」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I won't be able to keep watch」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm setting the trap, so face that way」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's embarrassed about havin' her panties seen」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, sorry!」
I hurriedly turned my back on Misa.

name: Paqy
message: 「They're probably not even that great of a pair of panties anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just because she dotes on you, what do you think you're saying...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh, string panties.」

name: Synn
message: 「String?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And a T-back, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How shameless...」

name: Paqy
message: 「My bad, it's a T-front.」

name: Synn
message: 「In the front?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus there's a zipper right over the important part.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is she planning to do with a zipper?!\s03」
Honestly, Misa, bringing underwear like that... It's making my heart pound!

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, that was all a lie.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're actually totally unsexy striped panties.」

name: Synn
message: 「Striped...」
Thank goodness. That's the Misa I know--wait, no, no!!

name: Misa
message: 「I'm finished.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright. Let's start the stakeout...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody's coming.」

name: Misa
message: 「How strange. I placed them in a spot similar to where Shio put hers.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's definitely 'cause Hys's panties have zero appeal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy! You might think so, but that doesn't mean everyone feels the same way, right?!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. Even your panties are plenty attracti--」

name: Synn
message: 「Kihaa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's because his owner doesn't discipline him properly!\s09」
Misa stormed off in anger.

name: Synn
message: 「Did she go home...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What're we gonna do, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't be helped. Let's keep going.」
It's getting pretty late...

name: Misa
message: 「Here」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Misa. Is that--」

name: Misa
message: 「I brought some work we can do while staying late.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on. We'll switch off, so go organize the paperwork or something in the meantime. I don't want to hear any excuses about the work falling behind because of me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry... I was sure you got mad and went home」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't underestimate me. I just went to cool my head for a bit.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... thanks」

name: Misa
message: 「No need to thank me. Now, we're sticking it out until the gates close.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right!」
However, the culprit never showed up in the end.

name: Paqy
message: 「I knew it, Hisu's panties--」
